note: Adapted from the species description in Chhotani (1997), originally in English: the alate is unknown and only the soldier and the worker are described; measurements are taken from the text; synonymy lists, distribution and figure numbers are not translated.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule straw yellow; nasus dark brown, paler at the base; antennae yellow, slightly darker towards the apex; pronotum and abdomen paler than the head; legs yellowish white. Head sparsely hairy, body rather densely hairy. Body length 3.50–4.20 mm. Head capsule pear-shaped, strongly constricted behind the antennae, widest posteriorly (length with nasus 1.37–1.58, length without nasus 0.90–1.00, maximum width 0.83–0.93, width at constriction 0.57–0.61 mm); in lateral view weakly concave behind the nasus, with a weak swelling. Nasus cylindrical, slightly longer than half the head length (length 0.46–0.60 mm, ratio of nasus length to head length 0.51–0.53). Fontanelle gland and duct distinct. Antennae 13-segmented; segment 3 about as long as segment 2; segment 4 shortest. Mandibles reduced, without lateral spiniform processes. Pronotum saddle-shaped; anterior lobe weakly raised, anterior margin without emargination; posterior margin convex (length 0.14–0.20, width 0.37–0.53 mm).

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule dark brown, paler anteriorly; antennae paler than the head; legs and body white. Head and body rather hairy. Body length 3.75–4.50 mm. Head capsule subquadrate (length to mandibular base 0.76–0.88, maximum width 0.92–1.00 mm); frontal suture distinct; fontanelle plate distinct. Antennae 14-segmented; segment 3 about as long as segment 2 or slightly shorter; segment 4 shortest. Postclypeus inflated, hairy; less than half as long as wide (length 0.14–0.18, width 0.35–0.42 mm). Pronotum saddle-shaped, anterior and posterior margins weakly concave (length 0.21–0.23, width 0.50–0.57 mm).
